verdict.rationale: The Voice Agent docs show that developers pick which TTS model speaks the agent and can A/B test voices across configurations, so voice selection is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows how broad the voice library is or that TTS providers other than Deepgram can be plugged in; the multi-provider evidence covers LLMs only and does not transfer to this story. Missing for 10: a documented voice catalog showing breadth, documented support for third-party TTS providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want
